summary: Re-chunk Orphic Hymns: drop 36 front-matter chunks (Taylor Dissertation + footnotes) carrying 209 accepted tags and 507 live edges

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
36 chunks in greek_mystery.orphic-hymns.001 through 034 (plus .087, .138) are Taylor's 'Dissertation on the Life and Theology of Orpheus' editorial front-matter, labeled 'Front Matter, p. N'. They carry 209 accepted concept tags and 507 live EXPRESSES/PARALLELS edges. The chunker config (chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml) uses page-as-chunk strategy with no drop_chunk_patterns for these pages.

The chunk bodies are genuine English prose about Orphic theology (theurgy, divine knowledge, etc.) — concepts that ARE valid in the taxonomy — so the tagger found real matches and the reviewer accepted them. But the content is editorial commentary, not the primary hymns.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml needs drop_chunk_patterns that match the front-matter pages (Taylor Dissertation on pages 2-6, footnote blocks on p.48 and p.93). The pattern should match 'DISERTATION ON THE LIFE AND THEOLOGY OF ORPHEUS' and 'FOOTNOTES' headers.

This is a whole-chunk drop (not in-place strip) because the front-matter pages are pure editorial content with no primary text — the chunker's shrink-guard would refuse a 0-content drop. This shifts chunk ids: the 102 actual hymn chunks would need renumbering, or the front-matter chunks simply removed and the hymn chunks preserved with stable ids.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
Driver task: Add drop_chunk_patterns to chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml for the 36 front-matter pages. Re-chunk orphic-hymns. This is the same pattern as d18a44cf (CH apparatus fix) and 2957d758 (Plotinus/Zhuangzi).

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
CORRECTION FROM DRIVER (2026-08-20): The ticket's chunk enumeration was wrong in three ways:

1. Chunk .087 is NOT front matter — it's Hymn XLII 'To the Seasons' ('XLII TO THE SEASONS. DAUGHTERS of Jove and Themis...'). It got the 'Front Matter, p. 48' label only because the source line 'XLII TO THE SEASONS' has no period after XLII, so number_pattern '^([IVXLCDM]+)\.' failed to match. .087 has 0 accepted tags and sits correctly between XLI (086) and XLIII (088). DROPPING IT = deleting Hymn XLII from the corpus.

2. Chunk .138 is a sacred-texts redirect page ('The new sacred-texts hypertext version of Homer's Iliad...'), not a footnote block. Drop-worthy, but for a different reason.

3. The proposed 'FOOTNOTES' drop pattern is CATASTROPHIC: 54 hymn chunks contain the word 'Footnotes' inline (e.g. Hymn I .035 ends 'Footnotes 114:* An epithet of Diana's...'). A drop_chunk_patterns regex on 'FOOTNOTES' would delete 54 real hymns, not just front material. Same risk with 'DISERTATION' (also misspelled in the ticket — source is 'DISSERTATION').

CORRECTED SCOPE: Drop 001–034 (34 contiguous front-matter pages) + .138 (redirect) = 35 chunks total. KEEP .087 (it's a hymn). Use drop_before_marker anchored on the first hymn 'I. TO THE GODDESS PROTHYRÆA' (verified unique to .035), not scattered drop patterns.

VERIFIED: 34 front-matter chunks carry 209 accepted tags + 478 live EXPRESSES+PARALLELS edges (source side) + 34 BELONGS_TO edges. Chunk .087 has 0 accepted tags. Chunk .138 has 0 accepted tags.

analysis.content:

2. Drop .138 separately with a precise anchor on 'hypertext version of Homer's Iliad'.

3. KEEP .087 — it's Hymn XLII 'To the Seasons', wrongly labeled as Front Matter because its Roman numeral 'XLII' lacks a trailing period, breaking number_pattern. The mislabel is a separate bug (label fix only, no chunk deletion).

4. Re-chunk orphic-hymns, then body-matched remap via scripts/migrations/apparatus_remap.py for the 209 accepted tags, re-embed, run round-trip.

Scope: 35 chunks dropped (.001–034 + .138), .087 preserved.
